_comment: The first end-to-end run of the run-eval skill. A control slice, not the full matrix. Its two useful outputs are a broken harness and a retracted interpretation.
protocol: Live tool calls through the deployed endpoints, via the eval-* subagents. Readable regime only.
slice: The control questions, which had gaps: overheating had never been run on the words arm.

finding_0_the_harness_was_stale.what: The skill still told the runner to score `max_calls` and to report `model_sensitivity` tables. Both fields were removed from the questions during the curation; no question could populate either. The skill's description had been updated, its scoring and reporting sections had not.
finding_0_the_harness_was_stale.why_it_matters: A harness nobody has run is a harness that does not work. This was found by trying to use it, not by reading it - and it would have produced a report keyed to fields that no longer exist.

finding_1_the_control_holds.question: overheating - temperatuuroverschrijding 3.59, above the 1.5 significant threshold

rich: inverted - 'low', and spent a second call on weather confirming it

finding_1_the_control_holds.reading: No arm wins. The words arm is 1 correct, 1 wrong, 1 partial across three runs - unstable rather than better. This is consistent with the earlier result that prose-only rules are a model cliff: every arm fails at Haiku, both arms pass at Opus.
finding_1_the_control_holds.verdict: THE CONTROL DID NOT SEPARATE, which is what a control is for. The other findings in this set are not undermined.
finding_1_the_control_holds.side_note: All three words runs made a second call to get_weather_context. The same compensating search appeared on thin and rich. When the payload does not settle a question, the model goes looking - regardless of arm.

finding_2_a_retraction.what: After the FIRST words run came back correct while thin and rich were both wrong, the immediate reading was that words beats rich - and a mechanism was proposed on the spot: that a curated alerts array suppresses attention to fields it does not cover, so rich infers 'not in alerts, not a problem'.
finding_2_a_retraction.then: Two more runs of the same cell returned 'LOW' and 'modest'. The effect was noise.
finding_2_a_retraction.why_this_is_recorded: It is the exact failure this whole exercise has been documenting - a mechanism inferred from n=1 - committed by the person documenting it, one run after writing that single runs mislead. The hypothesis may still be true and is worth a proper test; it is not evidence yet.
finding_2_a_retraction.if_tested_properly: Ask a question whose answer sits in a field NO alert covers, n>=5, words versus rich, and check whether rich systematically under-attends to it. temperatuuroverschrijding is the right field; this was the wrong n.

caveats: A control slice only: 5 runs. The full readable matrix is 9 questions x 3 arms x 3 repeats = 81, which was not attempted.
n=3 on the words cell, n=1 on thin and rich, carried over from the earlier sweep.
